title: Pre-warmed WM Singleton — TTFT Latency Reduction

convergence.interpretation: 5-step warmup reaches 95.4% of 60-step norm — within quality threshold

api_changes.AppState: Added efe, citta, bridge, domain_states fields
api_changes._load_all_components: New startup function loads all components + pre-warms 6 domains
api_changes._v1_generate: Uses singleton state instead of per-request load_trained_components()
api_changes.warmup_steps: Reduced from 60 to 5 for seed-specific requests (67ms vs 822ms)

note: EAGLE3 speculative decoding (originally S14) deprioritised — pre-warmed singleton eliminates the WM latency bottleneck. LLM token generation latency (~15 tok/s) is a separate concern addressed by streaming.
